title: Leverkusen-Paderborn: Leverkusen have six players out or doubtful
text:
Leverkusen-Paderborn: Leverkusen have six players out or doubtful Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board News 🇩🇪 Bundesliga 23h ago · November 20, 2026 Leverkusen-Paderborn: Leverkusen have six players out or doubtful
 Bundesliga matchday 10: Bayer Leverkusen host SC Paderborn on Saturday, 21 November, at BayArena, with the hosts fifth and the visitors 13th.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 20, 2026 at 09:54 AM 
 Live Bayer Leverkusen SC Paderborn 07 Saturday 21 November · 07:30 Line-ups, result and where to watch → Bayer Leverkusen host SC Paderborn 07 on Saturday, 21 November, at BayArena, in matchday 10 of the Bundesliga. The referee will be Tobias Reichel.
 Leverkusen are fifth with 16 points from nine matches and come in with three wins and two defeats in their last five. Paderborn are 13th with 10 points from nine, after one win, three draws and one defeat in their last five.

 For Leverkusen, K. Eichhorn (illness) and M. Terrier (muscle injury) are out; M. Diaby (hamstring), C. Kofane (muscle), I. Maza (ankle) and N. Tella (muscle) are doubtful. For Paderborn, N. Awortwie-Grant, T. Gayret (both knee) and M. Hoffmeier (muscle) are out, and T. Baack (injury, no details given) is doubtful.
 In the last five head-to-heads, Leverkusen have won four and Paderborn one. The most recent, on 29 October 2025, ended Paderborn 2-4 Leverkusen. Our data gives the hosts 45%, a draw 45% and the visitors 10%.
